differences.finding: Targeted fascia mask removed the lower gray context, but a dark upper context strip remains.
Awning mounting region remains darker and heavier than the reference; attempted edge mask was reverted as visually regressive.
Current upper trim remains generic and does not match the reference corner blocks exactly.
Facade still reads as assembled panels rather than one continuous storefront shell.
Foundation and landing remain more segmented and pale than the reference base.
Lighting is materially improved but still not as bright and clean as the reference.
